Confirmed — only one file changed, and the other untracked items (`.claude/agents/`, `.mcp.json`, `reports/`, `specs/`, `tests/unit/seed.spec.ts`) were already present before this task and are unrelated to it.

## Result: 5/6 pass, 1 correctly left red

**File changed:** `src/pages/legacy/LegacyEmiCalculatorPage.ts` (one file, by the `playwright-test-healer` agent — nothing else touched, no `.feature`/spec/step edits, so no `bddgen` regen was needed).

| Scenario | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Broken 1 (ambiguous role name) | `getByRole('link', {name: /Loan/})` → `getByRole('link', {name: 'Personal Loan', exact: true})` | Regex matched 13 links; exact name is unique. |
| Broken 2 (renamed id) | `locator('#loan-amount')` → `getByLabel('Home Loan Amount', {exact: true})` | Id no longer exists; switched to a label-based locator (matches the pattern already used in the working `EmiCalculatorPage`/`LoanForm`). |
| Broken 3 (absolute XPath) | DevTools XPath → `getByLabel('Interest Rate', {exact: true})` | XPath broke on any layout change; label is stable and matches the sibling page object. |
| Broken 4 (positional nth-child CSS) | nth-child chain → `locator('#emiamount p')` | No accessible label ties the heading to the value, so the id is the legitimate stable hook — same id the working page object already uses for this element. |
| Broken 5 (drifted heading text) | `getByRole('heading', {name: 'Monthly EMI'})` → `getByRole('heading', {name: 'Loan EMI', exact: true})` | Text drifted to "Loan EMI"; needed `exact: true` too, since a non-exact match also caught a sidebar "Home Loan EMI Calculator" heading (strict-mode violation on the first attempt). |
| Control (real assertion failure) | **Not changed.** | Locator (`#emiamount p`) is correct and resolves to the true EMI (₹44,986, matching the independent `calculateEmi()` oracle). The expected string `"₹33,000"` is the actual defect. Changing either would mask it, so the agent correctly left the test red rather than "healing" it — and it didn't resort to tagging it `@fixme`/skip either. |

Independently verified via `test_run`: 5 pass, the control fails with the same `Expected: "₹33,000" / Received: "₹44,986"` mismatch as before — exactly the intended outcome.

Worth noting versus the prior documented comparison run in `SELF_HEALING.md` §7: this run handled Broken 4 itself (last time your POC needed a human for it, which is expected since it only sees the a11y snapshot — this agent has DOM/browser access), and it resolved the control case cleanly without editing the feature file or tagging `@fixme` this time, so there was nothing for me to regenerate with `bddgen`. If you want, I can fold this cleaner run into the `self-heal/comparison/` evidence and update the §7 table.
